name: Pinch Hitter 2
author: Addicting Games
description: Pinch Hitter 2 is a free sports game. Put your batting skills to the test with these baseball challenges, and work your way up all the way from the sandlot to the major leagues. Can you work your way up through the ranks of baseball wannabees all the way up to the major leagues? You start with the meager sandlot, and then work your way up through that, into the little leagues, and eventually you go straight into the major leagues. Each set of challenges for each league tasks you with completing objectives like getting two homeruns back to back and hit 10 balls without any strikes or outs. It can prove to be challenging, but as they say—timing is everything.
